sam: Quick notes from a tiny bring-up experiment: 'Proposer-Verifier Rollforward' (PVR). Use a small proposer (3B q4) to speculate next tokens and only invoke the 70B verifier when proposer confidence is below a threshold. collecting early numbers + issues.

anya: nice. what confidence metric are you using?

sam: using normalized margin: (logit1 - logit2) / (median_entropy + 1e-6). median_entropy computed per model on a 2k calibrate set. threshold is route-configurable; target acceptance ~90%.

devon: verifier reuses prefix KV or recomputes? reuse is necessary for latency.

sam: reuse. verifier attaches to existing KV and only computes logits for candidate token(s). tried 1-token verify and 2-token lookahead. 2-token reduces misses but costs more.

priya: bench command + short results?

sam: ```
# bench (dev cluster)
python infra/bench_decode.py \\n  --model=redwood/70b-base-q8 \\n  --proposer=local/3b-q4 \\n  --gating=norm_margin \\n  --threshold=0.11 \\n  --batch=8 \\n  --seq_len=512 \\n  --profile
```

sam: summary (3 runs, 15k tokens):
- baseline (70B q8): p50=200ms/token, p95=410ms/token, cost=100u/1M tok
- PVR (3B proposer + verifier): p50=88ms/token, p95=230ms/token, cost~44u/1M tok
- acceptance ~90% (1-token)
- HH-RLHF 1k head-to-head win-rate = 49.0% vs baseline, delta logprob ~ -0.018

bench-bot: bench-job pvr_dev_7065432100 started (k8s 2026-03-21_11:02)

anya: solid p50. any clear failure modes?

sam: yes: long extractive summarization and code with rare symbols. proposer sometimes omits blockers/edge facts; gate missed ~3% steps on long-summ tests. example: proposer: "Team to ship next week." verifier: "Team flagged infra quota and pending security review; shipping delayed."

devon: mitigations? context-aware threshold, forced verifier every N tokens, moving-average confidence drift detector.

sam: added context-aware threshold: threshold *= (1 + 0.3 * min(context_len/1024,1.0)). reduces missed-facts but acceptance drops to ~86%.

priya: infra ops: please run matrix (proposer q4 vs q8) x (verify window 1/2) x thresholds 0.08/0.11/0.14 on dedicated pool with batch sizes 1/4/8 and export per-route traces to Console.

anya: eval plan: HH-RLHF 1k, LongSumm 600, CodeGen 600. metrics: human AB win-rate, pass@1, extractive recall, delta logprob. log acceptance by token position and prompt class. Also save diffs when verifier changes token (JSONL: prompt_id, pos, proposer_tok, verifier_tok, score).

devon: edge-case: tokenization mismatch due to quant stack differences. assert proposer.tokens(prefix)==verifier.tokens(prefix) before reusing KV; fallback to always verify when mismatch. add unit tests.

sam: implemented checks + tests. PR with code + eval harness + README on threshold defaults coming.

bench-bot: scheduled: eng-ml/dedicated-pvr-7065432100 (ETA 3h)

priya: monitoring: add metrics spec.accept_rate, spec.accept_by_pos, spec.verifier_trips, spec.human_delta_win per route. alert if accept_rate < 75% for 10m or human_delta_win < -0.06 over 24h.

sam: TL;DR: PVR shows ~2x-2.5x token-cost reduction and strong p50 wins. Quality regressions concentrate in low-entropy, long-context, and rare-token cases. threshold/context tuning + periodic forced-verifier reduces regressions but lowers acceptance. Opening WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/??? (draft).

anya: good. please include a small human-review panel for diffs where verifier changed tokens in LongSumm set.

priya: assigning follow-ups: @sam -> PR + diff dump, @devon -> token alignment tests + bench matrix, @anya -> eval protocol + human AB plan. I'll make JIRA. :spiral_calendar:
